sources.page_title: NISAR Level-2 Geocoded Covariance (GCOV) Product Guide
sources.paraphrased_summary: Defines GCOV format as gamma-naught power on a regular 20m UTM grid; specifies rtcGammaToSigmaFactor layer to convert gamma0 to sigma0 backscatter, and notes L-band NESZ noise floor requirement of approximately -23 dB.

Documents NISAR orbital altitude of 747 km in sun-synchronous dawn-dusk orbit, 12-day exact ground-track repeat cycle, 240+ km swath width, L-band (1.25 GHz, 24 cm wavelength) and S-band (3.2 GHz) radar instruments.

sources.page_title: The 1819 Rann of Kachchh Earthquake and the Allah Bund
sources.publisher: CIRES / University of Colorado Boulder (Prof. Roger Bilham)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Details 1819 intraplate thrust earthquake (magnitude Mw 7.7 to 8.2, nominal 7.8) producing an asymmetric surface fault scarp 50 to 90 km long with 2 to 6 m vertical uplift (up to 9 m local maximum), damming the Nara/Puran distributary of the Indus River.

sources.page_title: Holocene surface-rupturing paleo-earthquakes along the Kachchh Mainland Fault: shaping the seismic landscape of Kachchh, Western India
sources.paraphrased_summary: Analyzes Holocene surface rupture records, intraplate fault geometry, and recurring tectonic uplift across the Kachchh basin, verifying the Allah Bund scarp as an exposed tectonic surface landform rather than a subterranean structure.

sources.page_title: Performance of Traditional Bhungas in 2001 Bhuj Earthquake
sources.publisher: National Information Centre of Earthquake Engineering (NICEE) / IIT Kanpur
sources.paraphrased_summary: Field assessment demonstrating traditional circular Kutchi Bhungas suffered 0% structural shear collapse during the Mw 7.6-7.7 2001 Bhuj earthquake due to circular geometry eliminating corner shear concentrations and distributing lateral ground motion into continuous perimeter hoop tension.

sources.page_title: Kutch Desert Wildlife Sanctuary & Flamingo City Profile
sources.paraphrased_summary: Describes the 7,505 sq km Kutch Desert Wildlife Sanctuary, seasonal inundation of shallow brine (0.5 to 1.5 m) surrounding Khadir Bet, creating a natural water barrier protecting the Flamingo City breeding colonies from terrestrial predators.

sources.page_title: The Flamingo City in the Great Rann of Kutch
sources.publisher: Journal of the Bombay Natural History Society (Dr. Salim Ali)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Historic 1945 ornithological survey documenting an estimated colony of half a million Greater and Lesser Flamingos nesting on raised mud mounds in the Great Rann.

sources.page_title: 2020 & 2024 Population Estimation of Indian Wild Ass (Equus hemionus khur)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Official census counts reporting 6,082 individuals in 2020 and 7,672 individuals in 2024 across 15,510 sq km in the Little and Great Rann of Kutch; Schedule I under Wildlife Protection Act.

sources.page_title: Banni Grassland: Ecology, Pastoral Economy & Restoration
sources.publisher: ICAR / Gujarat Institute of Desert Ecology (GUIDE)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Documents Banni total area of approximately 2,618 sq km, livestock census of 48,982 buffalo and 10,681 cattle, invasive Prosopis juliflora spread from 6% in 1997 to 33% in 2009 and 54% in 2015, and dominant native sweet grass genera Dichanthium, Cenchrus, and Lasiurus.

sources.page_title: Measurements of the Dielectric Properties of Rock Salt for Microwave Radiodetection
sources.publisher: Physical Review D / arXiv:hep-ex/0108027 (Gorham et al.)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Experimental measurements of halite dielectric properties: pure solid halite exhibits real permittivity eps' of 5.9 to 6.0 with low dielectric loss (tan delta < 1e-4), whereas natural evaporite rock salt exhibits higher loss due to moisture and clay inclusions.

sources.page_title: Microwave Radar and Radiometric Remote Sensing (Chapters 2, 8, 10)
sources.publisher: University of Michigan Press (Fawwaz T. Ulaby and David G. Long)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Derives physical formulas for Bragg resonance roughness spacing lambda/(2 sin theta), Fresnel specular reflectivity for horizontal polarization, and low-loss microwave penetration depth delta_p = (lambda * sqrt(eps')) / (2 * pi * eps'').

sources.page_title: Mapping woody biomass in African savannas using ALOS PALSAR L-band SAR
sources.publisher: Remote Sensing of Environment (Mitchard et al.)
sources.paraphrased_summary: Empirical study documenting L-band cross-polarized HV backscatter saturation behavior in tropical savannas, showing sensitive aboveground biomass retrieval up to 40-60 Mg/ha before saturation.
